Author: deserokk
Name: DesCast
Description:
Places flat screens anywhere in a house. They sit in world space, foreshorten correctly from any angle, and are properly hidden by walls, furniture and people walking in front of them.

Show a picture from your PC or a link, or several on a rotation. Transparent images keep their transparency, so a crest or a cut-out sign floats rather than sitting in a black box.

Point everyone at one shared file and the whole Free Company sees the same boards, whether or not the person who placed them is online.
Punchline: Screens, signage and shared boards for your house
